title: Voice note
idea: Voice note: Recording state and elapsed time lead a playback review
audience: People who need to record audio within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Voice capture is the central task
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its record audio priority and explicit commitment contract: Never record before permission and explicit start
navigation: Voice note keeps the current record audio context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Recording state and elapsed time lead a playback review
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to record audio; voice capture is the central task
composition.priority: Never record before permission and explicit start

imagery.role: Support the actual record audio context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep stop and permission recovery reachable with one hand
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the voice note structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no record audio content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Never record before permission and explicit start
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized record audio content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Never record before permission and explicit start
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active record audio context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
